read: Read first: zid.sa/ar/legal/terms-conditions/ (evidence/product-class/runs/20261012T104936Z-s01-sources/items/122-zid.sa/raw.html, text taken from the page's markup) and zid.sa/en/legal/terms-conditions/ (20261012T045101Z-q1-zid-sources/items/194-zid.sa/raw.html), scanned for sanctions, countries, Yemen and residence: the sanctions and country lists sit only under the زد باي / ZidPay sections (ar: 'لا يجوز للتاجر استخدام زد باي في أي نشاط محظور ...'; en: 'Dealings with internationally sanctioned countries or entities.' under 'Merchants must not use Zid Pay for prohibited activities or dealings'); outside them only the legal-age clause ('the relevant laws and regulations of the country from which you use the Service') and a shipping clause ('Merchants located in Saudi Arabia or any of the Gulf countries can enable shipping through licensed logistics companies'), neither restricting who may open a store, use the dashboard or reach a storefront. Searches: python3 -I method/corpus_search.py zid 'عقوب' 'حظر' 'الدول المحظورة' 'sanction' 'sanctions' 'embargo' 'embargoes' 'restricted country' 'restricted countries' --max 5; python3 -I method/corpus_search.py zid 'الدول المدعومة' 'دول غير مدعومة' 'الدول غير المدعومة' 'OFAC' 'مراقبة الأصول' 'supported country' 'supported countries' 'unsupported country' 'unsupported countries' 'prohibited country' 'prohibited countries' --max 5; python3 -I method/corpus_search.py zid 'عقوب' 'حظر' 'محظور' 'sanction' 'sanctions' 'restricted' --with 'اليمن' 'Yemen' --max 5. Listed beyond the read pages: help.zid.sa/meta-restriction/ and help.zid.sa/whatsapp-app-vs-api/ (WhatsApp number bans), an Amazon FAQ, docs.zid.sa/localization and llms.txt (storefront supported-countries API): none a store-wide restriction by country or sanctions.

Read first (the route): zid.sa/ar/legal/zidpay-terms-conditions-kw/ (evidence/product-class/runs/20261012T045101Z-q1-zid-sources/items/188-zid.sa/raw.html) and zid.sa/ar/legal/zidpay-terms-conditions-sa/ (189-zid.sa/raw.html), text taken from the markup and scanned for عقوب, قائمة, مطابق, التحقق, غسل, اعرف عميلك, مزود الخدمة: under الأنشطة المحظورة both bar 'التاجر أو المستفيد النهائي (الشريك في عملية البيع والشراء) الذين طبقت عليهم عقوبات بناء على قرارات الأمم المتحدة، أو وزارة الخزانة الإنجليزية، أو الاتحاد الأوروبي، أو مكتب مراقبة الأصول الأجنبية، أو من هو مطالب للامتثال إذا كان الاسم مطابق لأي قائمة عقوبات أخرى.', but neither says who checks names against the lists, or with what. Searches: python3 -I method/corpus_search.py zid 'قائمة عقوبات' 'قوائم العقوبات' 'غسل الأموال' 'مكافحة غسل' 'تمويل الإرهاب' 'screening' 'screenings' 'sanctions list' 'sanctions lists' 'anti-money laundering' 'AML' --max 5 (3 documents: the two Zid Pay terms and the general terms); python3 -I method/corpus_search.py zid 'اعرف عميلك' 'العناية الواجبة' 'مزود خدمة الدفع' 'KYC' 'know your customer' 'due diligence' 'payment service provider' 'payment service providers' --max 5. Read: docs.zid.sa/merchant-activation.md (20261012T045101Z-q1-zid-sources/items/050-docs.zid.sa/text.txt), which says only that a merchant activating payments through a provider goes to 'a special login page for Zid merchants on the provider / partner side to provide the required information and documents in order to get onboarded', and docs.zid.sa/overview-1340225m0.md (052-docs.zid.sa/text.txt): neither names sanctions screening or its tool.

Read first (the route): zid.sa/en/legal/privacy-policy/ (evidence/product-class/runs/20261012T045101Z-q1-zid-sources/items/193-zid.sa/raw.html) and zid.sa/ar/legal/privacy-policy/ (186-zid.sa/raw.html), text taken from the markup and scanned for store, server, cloud, transfer, location, region, host, تخزين, خوادم, سحاب, نقل, خارج, استضاف: no country or region of storage. The nearest: under 'THE DATA TRANSFER ACROSS THE BORDERS', 'we may transfer or disclose your personal data to parties in other countries. However, such transfer or disclosure will only occur if appropriate safeguards are in place'; and under 'AI Data Processing', 'Zid Agent uses Google Cloud Vertex AI as a data processor to power AI-assisted features' and 'Google Cloud acts solely as an infrastructure provider and processor under Google Cloud's enterprise data processing terms', which names a processor for Zid Agent's features only, with no country or region. The general terms (ar, 20261012T104936Z-s01-sources/items/122-zid.sa/raw.html) were scanned in the N01 check: nothing on where data is stored. Searches: python3 -I method/corpus_search.py zid 'مراكز البيانات' 'مركز بيانات' 'خوادم' 'استضافة البيانات' 'data center' 'data centers' 'data centre' 'data centres' 'server' 'servers' 'data residency' 'hosted in' --max 5 (60 documents, the five listed are API docs and help.zid.sa/domain/ on name servers); python3 -I method/corpus_search.py zid 'تخزين البيانات' 'حفظ البيانات' 'داخل المملكة' 'AWS' 'Amazon Web Services' 'Google Cloud' 'Azure' 'cloud region' 'cloud regions' 'data storage' --max 5. Read: docs.zid.sa/upload-file-to-s3-11396102e0.md (20261012T045101Z-q1-zid-sources/items/063-docs.zid.sa/text.txt): 'the AWS access key id needed for authenticated access to the S3 bucket', with no region or amazonaws address.
